affordance_in_statement: A safety rule triggers a system fault if and only if the panel's final configuration contradicts both of its monitored target settings at the same time. If the configuration matches one or both of the target settings, the rule remains silent.
removal_suggestion: Rather than presenting rules directly as pairs of signed switch literals $(l_1, l_2)$, wrap the constraints in a different domain (e.g., intervals of allowed switch states, implication chains in a simulated circuit, or parity relations between switches) so the 2-SAT structure is not immediately recognizable as standard 2-CNF clauses.
